title: GoodRx Price Lookup Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodrx:price
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by drug_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when GoodRx price lookup data has stopped arriving for a given drug.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per drug and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your GoodRx price lookup feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
